_about: Two level-15 backpacks' new bonuses (the owner, 2026-11-16). Modification 1052: three ammo bags (parameters/ammo_bags_modifier +3), made like 1051 (type 17, never rolled: drop weight 0, card property 20), for the Backpack for ammo (eq046_bm_back_10). Modification 1320: artefact actives last 15 % longer (parameters/artefact_duration_modifier +0.15, player modifier 39, the Knowledge of Artifacts skill's), type 42, a type of its own (never rolled), card property 176 "Artifact active time" (a percentage, higher is better, made like 103), for the Pilgrim container (edge_back_6). An armour item makes a player modifier of each of its 68 parameters that is not 0, as a booster does (the armour's constructor 0x33EAA0, its 0x44 loop over item+0x108), and the item cook skips a modifier whose key the config lacks, so the Pilgrim's config gets the key at 0. Modification 1340: the Pilgrim gives its wearer the artefact skill Resonance (541; the owner, 2026-11-16: with Cascade too, the tree's either/or left as it is): parameters/artefact_power_modifier +16, the skill's own bit of modifier 40, type 43, a type of its own (never rolled), card property 177 (the skill's name, +1, made like 20). No config has that key, so the item cook skips it and the exe adds nothing; srp sets the bit into the wearer's kit modifier 40 (loadouts::give_worn_skills), so one who has the skill gets nothing more. armor.tsv says who has them, modifications.tsv holds their values.
